title: Montauk experiments behind Stranger Things

tellings.quote: I think even the makers of Stranger Things say that uh it's based off of, you know, the Montauk experiments and I I think it's pretty well established that there were some experiments in Montauk, Long Island.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that even the makers of Stranger Things, a popular TV series about secret government experiments, say it is based on the Montauk experiments. Michels says it is pretty well established that some experiments took place at Montauk, on Long Island, New York, though he doesn't say what they were. People tell the story because it suggests strange secret research really happened there.
